name: manual_d0cc3e
claim: Replacing a file from an anchor to the end of the file (s[i:] = new) silently deletes every definition after the anchor. After any tail replacement, confirm the later symbols still exist before running anything else, and prefer replacing between two anchors. A test run caught it (AttributeError on a function defined after the edited one); the deleted functions were restored from the committed version.
conditions: scripted edit tail replacement deleted functions

decisions.notes: 2026-11-17: editing the last section of seat_contracts.py removed select_effort, default_wandb_turn and plan_turn; 32 tests failed with AttributeError; restoring the tail from git HEAD fixed it.
